children.game_version: Children pair up to practice holding crossed hands and seeing how smoothly they can twirl together for short counts.

avoid: Sudden pulling forces on shoulders and wrists
seniors.counts: Continuous steady cadence without rapid acceleration.
seniors.seated_version: Two seated participants sit face-to-face, hold hands gently, and guide their arms in rhythmic circular patterns.
seniors.standing_version: Perform slow-paced hand-held circular movement without leaning backward or fast spinning.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slow tempo with minimal inclination of the torso.

learning_units.description: Crossed-hand interlocking balance grip and backward lean inclination.

social_formats.description: Paired face-to-face rotation or four-person group rotation surrounded by singing and clapping onlookers.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms crossed in front of partner, extended to maximum strain, hands interlocked securely.
movement_profile.footwork: Wheeling rapidly and continuously in small circular paths while maintaining counter-balanced weight.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Small stationary circular footprint, twirling in place in pairs or groups of four.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso tilted backward away from partner to establish centrifugal balancing forces.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Upright standing posture with continuous ground balance; no jumps described.
movement_profile.partnering: Face-to-face counterweight balance with interlocked crossed hands.
movement_profile.posture: Body inclined backward with arms crossed, fully extended, and hands interlocked firmly with partner.

signature_moves.description: Two dancers hold crossed hands, lean back to stretch arms fully, and spin continuously in a tight circle.
signature_moves.name: Interlocked Twirl

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid releasing the hand grip prematurely or losing counter-balance posture during high-speed rotation.

music_profile.musical_form: Vocal folk song with audience clapping
music_profile.sound_description: Vocal folk singing accompanied by hand clapping and the continuous tinkling of dancers' anklets as they spin.
music_profile.vocal_style: Folk songs sung by surrounding women to encourage faster movement

basic_steps: Stand face-to-face close to a partner.
Cross arms and interlock hands firmly with the partner.
Incline body backward until arms are stretched to maximum length.
Wheel round continuously in rapid circular motions while maintaining balance.
teaching.formation: Pair face-to-face circle, or four-person joined circle.
teaching.level_notes: Requires strong upper-body tension, counter-balancing with a partner, and steady footwork during fast spinning.
